semiconductor_relevance: High — Clas-SiC Wafer Fab is a dedicated foundry for Silicon Carbide power semiconductors, supporting various stages of product development.
summary: Clas-SiC Wafer Fab is the world's first dedicated open foundry for manufacturing Silicon Carbide power semiconductors, enabling fabless design houses and semiconductor companies to efficiently enter the SiC market. The company offers comprehensive support throughout the product lifecycle, from design to low-rate production and licensing for high-volume manufacturing.
capabilities: Manufacturing of Silicon Carbide power semiconductors
Development of process design kits (PDKs) for SiC devices
Transitioning tech devices into low-rate production
Licensing support for scaling to high-volume manufacturing
